## Setup

### Python and Virtual Environment Installation

``` sh
* curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh uv python install 3.13
```

### Install programming_first_principles in Development mode

``` sh
$ uv pip install -e .
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/gophry/programming-first-principles):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/gophry/programming-first-principles.git
```

### Commiting Changes

- nbdev-export
  - Exports source code to modules from notebooks
- nbdev-test
  - extracts and executes code cells across your Jupyter notebooks to
    ensure that your library, documentation, and unit tests function
    without error
- nbdev-preview
  - Preview how the website documentation looks like.
- nbdev-clean
- git commit and git push origin main
